title: Onset-actor repair of a native pause-relative recovery scar
prior_basis: Phase13 B selected as hypothesis-generating basis, not included in this new primary: native AUC -1.57, late -.875, actor rescue1.46; independent8 had a successful compound result. No screening of new settings or seed subsets.
single_primary_claim: Temporary late reward corruption leaves a practically substantial native pause-relative cost through the tested horizon, and replacing only onset actor parameters repairs that cost while reciprocal actor transfer reproduces it.

primary.method: single intersection-union claim, p=max of four prespecified one-sided paired-t p values; all four required

contrasts.name: onset_actor_rescue
contrasts.quantity: AUC(CDD)-AUC(native D), D context and D critic/moments

contrasts.name: reciprocal_actor_transfer
contrasts.quantity: AUC(DCC)-AUC(CCC), D context and onset critic/moments

primary.consistency: at least24 of32 seeds have negative native AUC cost, and at least24 have positive actor rescue; report every seed
primary.inference: 95% and99% paired-t CIs; also simultaneous one-sided95% Bonferroni bounds over the four components, exact paired-sign tests and fixed-seed bootstrap sensitivity (secondary). No episode/checkpoint pseudoreplication.

margin_rationale: AUC .50 is about8% of prior clean recovery score6.0 and one third of prior native cost1.57; late .30 is5% of that scale and well below prior late cost. These are practically substantial but not selected from new data.

secondary.restoration: Residual CDD minus matched onset CCC and versus historical pause: TOST +/- .30 (5% prior clean score), not literal zero; report failure if margin not cleared.
secondary.fresh_moments: common freshly initialized Adam in all4 actor x critic cells; report two-factor actor main effect, both background swaps and total; not a natural optimizer decomposition
secondary.reset_context: same actor-rescue contrast after a fresh environment reset, with unchanged future RNG/counter; report all differences and comparisons with natural context
secondary.independent_evaluation: repeat native AUC/late cost and actor-rescue contrast with second key54321; do not select or pool eval keys for primary
secondary.specificity: one game, one impairment family, small MLPs, one finite recovery horizon; no irreversible-loss, complete representation mechanism or universal dominance claim

withholding: no formal primary analysis until all32 planned seeds have every requested cell; logs contain progress only. No seed expansion, endpoint changes, alternate-setting search or positive-result guarantee.
fallback: if interrupted or budget-incomplete, retain all partial results, no confirmatory primary verdict. Recovery may resume completed cells only after identical state fingerprints/configuration and overlapping cell results are verified. No outcome-driven continuation.
resume: Recompute pre-fork history and verify exact C/D/onset fingerprints before reuse of completed cells; original summary/source files remain archived. No silent replacement of mismatching data.
software_smoke: seed99992, CartPole, short software-only window/recovery; never enters inference or tunes scientific choices
